title: CSN Tracker
description: Automatically exports your Chest Shop Sale history and makes CVS file from it, you can also wire it to your discord bot using webhook link.
body:
CSN Tracker
CSN Tracker is a Fabric utility mod for Minecraft players who run shops using ChestShop Notifier. It automatically scrapes your /csn history and exports every transaction into clean CSV files — so you always know what you've sold, what you've spent, and how much you've earned.

What it does
Press K to kick off a full history export. The mod pages through your entire /csn history automatically, collects every transaction, strips out duplicates, and writes the results to .minecraft/sales/ — no manual copying, no missed pages.

Features

One-keybind export — press K to capture your full transaction history; progress shown in the action bar
Full pagination — handles any number of history pages at a safe 5 commands/sec
Deduplication — SHA-256 hashing ensures entries are never double-counted across runs
Per-period transaction log — csn_export_<period>.csv with every buy and sell
Monthly summary CSV — aggregated stats per item: quantities sold/bought, coins earned/spent, number of transactions
Discord webhook — optionally posts your export report to a Discord channel automatically on finish
In-game settings screen — configure your webhook and item name aliases without leaving the game
Brew aliases — map raw CSN item names (e.g. Potion#32L) to readable display names


Requirements

Minecraft: 1.21.4
Mod loader: Fabric
Required: Fabric API
Server plugin: ChestShop Notifier must be installed on your server


Who is this for?
If you run a shop on a survival or economy server and use ChestShop Notifier, CSN Tracker gives you a full financial picture of your shop — without any manual record-keeping. Pair it with the companion Discord bot for automatic reports delivered straight to your server.
